headline: KIA to set up 2nd manufacturing unit in Andhra Pradesh; Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, Latham & Watkins advise
sum: Kia India Private Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding, dated November 12, 2026, with the Government of Andhra Pradesh, to establish the brand's second manufacturing facility in Andhra Pradesh. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co…
detail: Kia India Private Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding, dated November 12, 2026, with the Government of Andhra Pradesh, to establish the brand's second manufacturing facility in Andhra Pradesh. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised KIA on this transaction and assisted with the finalization of the transaction documents. The transaction was led by Shruti Kinra (Partner) and Rohan Sharda (Partner), with support from Pooja Oorath (Senior Associate). The incentives team comprised Sanjiv Malhotra (Senior Advisor) and Aayush Nagpal (Partner).
